rows.grounds: gloss 'own+valor'; vikramaṃ = m.acc.sg of vikrama (valor), compounded with sva (own)
gloss 'having-displayed'; form khyāpayitvā from causative of √khyā (to proclaim/display)
gloss 'Indra'; proper name Śakra, nominative singular śakra/śakro
gloss 'god+lord'; patiḥ m.nom.sg compounded with deva (god) → deva-patiḥ
gloss 'made'; kṛtaḥ m.nom.sg of kṛta from √kṛ (to do/make)
